name: Graph-based Isosurface Segmentation (Min-Cut)
definition: A technique to segment voxels containing a specific isosurface by treating them as an interconnected network (graph) and finding an optimal cut to separate foreground and background seed points.
summary: Graph-based Isosurface Segmentation uses min-cut optimization on a sparse graph of isosurface voxels to separate user-defined seeds, avoiding the computational expense of full voxel grid processing.
